integrity: All general claims are justified by a self-contained infinite-family proof. Finite exhaustive enumeration and BFS are supplementary checks, not replacements for that proof. No independent validation has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Proves the complete structure, number and token-jumping connectivity of minimum paired dominating sets for n>=6 only; excludes the n=5 boundary. Counts vertex sets, not a chosen induced perfect matching. Bibliographic equivalence outside inspected records remains possible.
title: Optimal paired domination and connected reconfiguration in \(\mathrm{KG}(n,2)\)
